title: Evidence handoff daybook - quick personal log
body:
Morning sprint notes (22 Mar 2026) - fast capture before handoff:

Context:
- Weekly: prepping a short handoff for SOC2 evidence collection while I'm OOO next week. Need a minimal bundle (owner, file, short description, where uploaded).
- Goal: reduce back-and-forth for evidence owners and make next steps explicit.

Top priorities (today):
- Finish evidence map for Access Control (AC) and System Operations (SO).
- Validate vendor attestations for KMS and Secrets manager vendors we onboarded in Q1.
- Drop a short checklist in the security-evidence Slack thread and tag Maya for reviews.

Quick TODO (checklist):
- [ ] AC-02: Access provisioning log export (owner: Maya) --> confirm CSV exists + hash. File name pattern: ac-02-provisioning-yyyy-mm.csv
- [ ] AC-06: MFA enforcement screenshot + policy excerpt (owner: Priya) --> need console screenshot and policy paragraph.
- [ ] SO-03: Patch management calendar (owner: infra-team) --> ask infra for monthly cadence doc + last 3 months receipts.
- [ ] Vendor: VaultCo KMS attestation (owner: Ramon) --> collect SOC2 letter or AICPA PDF, last 12 months.
- [ ] Vendor: AcmeSecrets (new) security questionnaire (owner: vendor-ops) --> follow up on unanswered Q4 items (Q6, Q12).

Notes on evidence quality / minimal acceptance criteria:
- Must include a date (YYYY-MM-DD) and an owner in metadata or filename.
- Prefer original PDFs or signed attestations. Screenshots accepted only as backup; include path to upstream logs.
- Hash (sha256) optional but helpful for reviewers.

Vendor review quick notes - initial findings:
- VaultCo (KMS): Has 2025 SOC2 Type II PDF (redacted PII allowed). Need verification: is the scope covering keys used by Redwood Private? Jira: JIRA-SEC-421 references scope question. Action: request confirmation from VaultCo rep (emailed; follow-up in 48h).
- AcmeSecrets: Completed questionnaire but answers on encryption-at-rest ambiguous. Ask for network diagram and key rotation policy. Put escalation if no reply in 5 business days.

Policy TODOs (short drafts / edits to finish before handoff):
- "Vendor attestation intake" SOP: one-page checklist + sample email template. Draft status: 40% (outline in Confluence).
- "Evidence naming convention" doc: enforce prefix (control-id) + date + owner. Draft bullet points only.
- "Screenshots vs logs" guideline: add to evidence index clarifying acceptable artifacts.

Handoff notes for whoever picks this up:
- Slack: post summary to #security-evidence with next steps and tag "@vendor-ops" and "@infra-oncall" for missing docs.
- Upload path: shared_drives/company/misc/SOC2-evidence (ask Maya to confirm final folder).
- If vendor returns stale attestation (>12 months), escalate to Legal for contract clause check.

Open questions / things I couldn't finish:
- Did infra produce monthly patch receipts for Jan-Feb 2026? My ping last week timed out. If not, mark SO-03 partial and request interim note.
- Confirm that the KMS scope includes Private deployments—not just Hosted API. Need vendor confirmation.

Messages to leave in thread when handing off (short copy):
"Quick handoff: finishing evidence mapping for AC & SO controls. See daybook + checklist. @Maya please confirm AC-02 CSV and upload to shared drive. @Priya need MFA screenshot + policy paragraph. Ramon on vendor attestations (VaultCo, AcmeSecrets) — I emailed both; follow-ups in 48/120h. I'll be OOO from 2026-03-25 to 2026-03-29. Tag me only for urgent escalations."

Micro-notes to self before leaving:
- Export AC-02 raw CSV and attach to Confluence page (label: ac-02-provisioning-2026-03).
- Create the single-page Vendor SOP and save as vendor-intake-sop-v1.pdf.
- Run a quick grep in infra logs for patch timestamps (command I used last time: `grep -E "patch|update" /var/log/patches | tail -n 200`).

Next actions (order):
1) Ping infra for SO-03 receipts (urgent)
2) Confirm upload location and naming with Maya
3) Draft vendor SOP and post to Confluence + share link in slack
4) Request explicit scope confirmation from VaultCo rep (copy legal if not answered in 48h)

End of quick log. Keep this file as a living daybook: small, write-only notes for the short handoff window.

-- Ramon
